title: Gravitational lens
description: A hovering lens bends a precise vermilion drafting grid.
useCase: Optical interfaces, scientific identities, and interaction-driven distortions of procedural art.
reducedMotion: A representative frame remains still. Live system preference changes immediately stop the loop; the range control continues to update the still image.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1. A static CSS fallback appears when unavailable or after context loss. A screen-space lens illustration; the title is metaphorical and does not imply general-relativistic simulation.
look: Cream drafting paper with a fine vermilion square grid and one bold black diagonal band, magnified by a clear glass disc with a grey rim.
motion: A circular lens magnifies the grid beneath it and bobs vertically on a slow sine (about 27 s per cycle); a position slider moves it horizontally; a button pauses.
adapt: The lens is in the `FRAGMENT` shader: `center` takes x from `u_control` plus a `sin(u_time*.23)` bob, `.38` sets magnification, and the 0.27 radius recurs in `mask`, `z` and `rim`; `spacing` sizes the grid. Keep the canvas lifecycle and fallbacks.
